title: Round-4 fixes: port.c P1+P2 security findings
description: Fix four SEC findings from round-4 review: (1) P1: failed re-key leaves stale fd in devCtx causing silent key confusion; (2) P2: CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for owned-key ECDSA when fd gone (should be WC_HW_E); (3) P2: eccverify.res not NULL-checked before write; (4) P2: no ForceZero on init_op in hash early-return path.
